packageRules.description: Only stable ONNX Runtime Web releases; every update needs Matcha gates
prBodyNotes: Matcha gate: run `pnpm test:matcha-fst:tables`, `pnpm test:matcha-kaldifst-wasm`, `pnpm benchmark:matcha`, and `pnpm benchmark:matcha-stream`.
`candidate-gate` must pass waveform validity, three-run RTF, 512 MiB memory budget, ASR CER, and zero underflow/append/producer errors before automerge.

packageRules.description: Upstream assets and native WASM toolchain use the automated Matcha gates
prBodyNotes: The PR checks out the selected Matcha revision, records asset SHA-256 values, and runs the complete candidate gate.
Matcha/Vocos/FST gate: acoustic model, Vocos, lexicon/tokens, fixed phone/date/number order, 32-case golden output, valid waveform, RTF, 512 MiB memory budget, and ASR CER.
kaldifst/OpenFST/Emscripten changes must also pass the native WASM rebuild and browser golden checks.
